context_rule.default_input: smallest sufficient changed observations plus affected dependency closure

material_examples: rights authority privacy or security boundary change
failed test invariant proof obligation or independent verification
new evidence capable of overturning a conclusion
dependency change invalidating a reusable result
high or unresolved uncertainty above the owning profile threshold
freshness expiry for an active high-value question
not_material_examples: same source hash and same relevant state
no-change reviewer result with no new evidence
elapsed time below an applicable freshness deadline

required_when: dependency closure is unknown or incomplete
DesignEpoch or canonical source root changed
high-risk semantic change crosses multiple owners or files
bounded context cannot establish whether an invariant or contract is affected
whole-source Compare Proof Evidence or Tier-A closure is explicitly required
periodic assurance or audit obligation explicitly requires full revalidation
contradiction or contamination cannot be resolved from the compact packet
full_context_fallback.rule: Delta-first optimization MUST NOT weaken whole-source or closure requirements. If sufficiency is uncertain, expand context or stop with PACKET_INCOMPLETE/UNKNOWN rather than guessing.

post_merge_verification.default_context: changed paths, affected contracts/invariants, original finding and exact-head evidence

canonical_design_review.wake_on: material design delta, unresolved finding or dependency invalidation
canonical_design_review.default_context: bounded SectionUnit plus affected dependency closure
canonical_design_review.full_context_fallback: mandatory when semantic closure cannot be bounded

research_intake.wake_on: new unique source/evidence or expiry of an active research claim
research_intake.default_context: new evidence, prior conclusion if needed, contradictions and provenance
research_intake.avoid: resummarizing already-seen sources with unchanged fingerprints

review_packet_construction.wake_on: work item or closure frontier change
review_packet_construction.default_context: changed closure frontier plus required dependencies

blind_review.wake_on: new material packet or missing required independent family
blind_review.avoid: rerunning completed families on unchanged packet hashes

cross_examination.wake_on: new independent finding, contradiction or reviewer challenge
cross_examination.default_context: own finding plus only relevant peer findings and source packet
cross_examination.avoid: cross-examination with no new independent evidence

branch_pr_hygiene.wake_on: branch/PR state change or freshness deadline
branch_pr_hygiene.avoid: full branch inventory rescans when state fingerprints are unchanged

implementation_and_integration.wake_on: validated change request, failing verification or dependency change
implementation_and_integration.default_context: changed paths, affected symbols/contracts/tests and integration collisions
implementation_and_integration.full_context_fallback: expand tests/context when impact analysis is incomplete

pipeline_health.wake_on: health signal change or freshness deadline
pipeline_health.default_context: changed/stale health receipts and failing lanes
pipeline_health.full_context_fallback: full audit when health evidence is stale, missing or contradictory

repo_reconciliation.wake_on: new receipts, state drift, pending-work change or freshness deadline

protocol_and_pipeline_simplification.wake_on: measured complexity/growth change or applicable freshness deadline
protocol_and_pipeline_simplification.default_context: changed process artifacts and measured duplication

successor_composition.wake_on: new admitted semantic delta or material predecessor change
successor_composition.default_context: admitted deltas plus affected five-file closure
successor_composition.full_context_fallback: release materialization still requires complete release/reference checks

knowledge_refresh.wake_on: new, overturned, expired or dependency-invalidating knowledge
knowledge_refresh.default_context: affected dependency subtree and evidence ancestry
knowledge_refresh.avoid: global knowledge rebuild when unaffected records remain fresh

frontier_chatgpt_review.wake_on: qualified materiality receipt and compact request availability
frontier_chatgpt_review.avoid: using ChatGPT as a universal hop between agents

invariants: EDW-001 no recurring clock is required to process unchanged state
EDW-002 duplicate event fingerprints do not create duplicate governed work
EDW-003 expensive/frontier synthesis requires an explicit materiality receipt
EDW-004 compact context preserves evidence ancestry and relevant contradictions
EDW-005 stale context cannot support current claims without revalidation
EDW-006 delta-first processing never weakens required whole-source closure
EDW-007 OpenRouter and the external ChatGPT frontier lane remain distinct provider/authority surfaces
EDW-008 ChatGPT frontier review is proposal evidence only and cannot replace independent-family requirements
EDW-009 due intervals are freshness constraints, not polling instructions
EDW-010 no cost or compute saving claim is accepted without measured receipts
authority_boundary: This implementation profile changes scheduling/context economy only. It grants no truth, Proof, authority, semantic admission, canonical promotion or deployment permission.
